plan.headline: The tranexamic serum is working. Pause the retinal: your redness got worse after you started it. Buy nothing.
plan.summary: Six weeks after your new products, your rescan tells a mixed story. Age spots improved by 8.3 points (raw 44.2 to 52.5) and texture by 5.3 (57.6 to 62.9). Both are real changes, bigger than the ±4 noise. But redness got worse by 7.3 points (raw 66.4 to 59.1), and that started when you added the retinal serum. It sits on the same nights as 10% glycolic pads on skin the scan reads as redness-prone. Keep the tranexamic serum, because it is working. Pause the retinal so your skin can calm down. Use the pads only twice a week. Your cleanser, night balm and SPF 50 cover the basics. Nothing is missing, so you don't need to buy anything.

verdicts.reason: Working. It fades dark spots, and your age-spot score improved 8.3 points (44.2 to 52.5) in 6 weeks. It is gentle, so use it morning and night.

Irritating. Redness got 7.3 points worse (66.4 to 59.1) after you started it, on skin the scan reads as redness-prone. Stop for now. Once redness recovers, you could try it again 2 nights a week, never on pad nights.

These exfoliate (clear dead skin) for texture and glow. Texture is up 5.3 points (57.6 to 62.9). They are strong (10% glycolic acid) for redness-prone skin, so use them just 2 nights a week while redness recovers.
A gentle ceramide cleanser that protects your skin barrier. Moisture is at 62.8 raw, so this is the right kind of cleanser for you.
Your night moisturizer. It locks in water (moisture 62.8 raw) and soothes skin after the pads.
Daily SPF 50 is the most important step for you. It protects your age-spot gains (52.5 raw) and helps with wrinkles (54.1) and redness (59.1).

skip.label: Another retinol or retinal serum
skip.reason: You already own one, and it is what irritated your skin. A second retinoid would make redness worse.

skip.label: Eye creams for dark circles, bags or tear trough
skip.reason: Dark circles (61.7) and eye bags (68.9) are only at watch level. Tear trough (63.0) is about structure under the skin, and no cream can change it.

skip.label: BHA exfoliant
skip.reason: Acne (87.6) and pores (71.2) are fine. A second acid would only add irritation.

skip.label: Peptide firming serum ($68)
skip.reason: Firmness is at watch level (61.0) and the serum is over your $50 budget. Your night balm and SPF already help.

notes: Sunscreen is the last morning step. Use two finger-lengths for face and neck.
Retinal is paused. Don't use it until your next rescan shows redness has recovered.
Pads only on Tuesday and Friday. Let them dry before the serum and balm.

look.note: Your skin has a warm undertone. 220N Medium is the closest match (deltaE 2.4, a very small colour difference). Rosewood is close to your natural lip colour. Coral Wash and Peach are warm picks for a brighter look.

checkin.note: Rescan in 6 weeks. If redness has recovered to about 64 raw or better, try the retinal again 2 nights a week, never on pad nights. Keep watching age spots and texture.

caveats: If the pads sting or your skin looks redder, pause them too and use only the cleanser, tranexamic serum, balm and SPF.
Wrinkle (54.1) and firmness (61.0) gains from the retinal take about 12 weeks. Pausing it slows those gains for now, but calm skin comes first.
The preview shows the best likely result, not a promise. Results vary.
